title: [29.X]- The Available to Take logic is incorrect or inaccurate in the Pick Worksheet as it includes Ship and Receive bin inventory
summary: The Available to Take logic in the Pick Worksheet incorrectly included inventory from Ship and Receive bins. The calculation was corrected to exclude these bin types from availability calculations.
key_points: Available to Take quantity in Pick Worksheet was inflated by including Ship and Receive bin inventory
Modified Warehouse Availability Management codeunit to properly filter bins
Pick Worksheet now shows accurate available inventory for picking operations
Extensive test coverage added for the corrected logic
